title: Dev Loop lane specification (v2)
description: One orchestrator run: base ref, layout, default worker settings, N lanes. Each lane = one git worktree + one worker in one harness + one two-sided merge gate. Strict: unknown keys are rejected so a typo cannot silently disable a control.

objective.description: Run-level objective (the L0 Definition of Done). Lanes carry their own.

base_ref.description: Git ref every lane branches from (main, origin/main, a SHA).

worktree_root.description: Relative dir holding one worktree per lane; orchestrators add it to .git/info/exclude.

terminal_layout.description: auto = tmux_grid on POSIX / wt_grid on Windows if available, else detached. headless = run lanes sequentially in the foreground.

integration_cmd.description: Optional command run on the base branch after all merges (whole-project integration suite).

worker.description: Default worker settings; each lane may override any key.

harness.description: Which agent runs the lane. See references/harness-adapters.md for the exact command each expands to.

command.description: custom harness only (or override for any): template with {obj} {wt} {report} {lane_json} {n} {t} placeholders.

model.description: Model id passed to the harness (--model / lane model for openai-compatible).

effort.description: Reasoning effort passed as --effort to the harnesses that take it (claude-code, antigravity). adapters.py defaults claude-code lanes to xhigh and omits the flag elsewhere when unset.

base_url.description: openai-compatible: API root, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1.

api_key_env.description: NAME of the env var holding the key. Never the key.

max_turns.description: Applied where the harness supports it (claude-code, openai-compatible).

allowed_tools.description: claude-code: --allowedTools value (default Read,Edit,Write,Glob,Grep,Bash). copilot: comma list of --allow-tool patterns, e.g. shell(git:*),shell(pytest:*),write (default --allow-all-tools; git push/commit always denied).

extra_args.description: Appended verbatim to the harness command line.

env.description: Environment injected into the worker process (non-secret values; secrets by env NAME only).

structured_output.description: claude-code/codex: enforce the devloop_report schema natively (--json-schema / --output-schema). Others fall back to the fenced-JSON parser.

output_format.description: gemini-cli: text (default, safer — json aborts on non-fatal tool errors) or json.

id.description: Lane id → worktree dir and branch lane/<id>. (v1 alias: worker_id)

domain.description: Subsystem domain for L1 grouping (backend, frontend, qa, security, infra, docs).

objective.description: The lane's Definition-of-Done objective. (v1 alias: command)

owned_paths.description: Exclusive globs this lane may modify; the host rejects a diff touching anything else.

read_paths.description: Extra paths the worker should read (never modify).

worktree.description: Override worktree path (default <worktree_root>/<id>). Must be relative and contain no '..'.

positive_cmd.description: Must exit 0 on the finished worktree. (v1 alias: test_cmd)

negative_control_cmd.description: Must exit non-zero AND leave the tree exactly as it found it (trap cleanup).

negative_expect.description: Regex (ERE / .NET) that must match the negative control's combined output -- it must name the planted violation. Prefer the tool's OWN error for a real mutation. Where the plant is synthetic, use the sentinel DEVLOOP-PLANTED-<LANE_ID> (lane id uppercased, non-alphanumerics to '-'): it must appear in negative_control_cmd, be unique to this lane, and not exist in the tree. Never alternate it with text the tool prints anyway -- that makes the control pass without the plant. See SKILL.md section 6.

full_gate_cmd.description: Optional whole-project gate run in the worktree after both controls.

depends_on.description: Lane ids that must merge before this lane starts (DAG; cycles rejected).

extra_context.description: Free text appended to the lane prompt.

mutation_cmd.description: Optional mutation-testing gate scoped to the lane's diff (mutmut --CI, cargo mutants, stryker); must exit 0. Surviving mutants = tests that cannot fail.

task_id.description: Id of the task in .devloop/tasks.jsonl this lane implements; the host writes it as a Task-Id: commit trailer and flips the task to done on merge.
